__note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for each player's admission year. The academic year shown on the site (Team, Ladder, Home) is auto-calculated from this and increments every August. To update a player: set their admission year as a 4-digit number (e.g. 2024). Use "graduated" to show a Graduated badge instead of a year. Set null / leave a value you don't know yet — it will simply show no year until filled. Names MUST match team.json and ladder.json exactly. There is no year cap: 4th, 5th year etc. are all valid.
